statement: The new AWS commitment sits on top of a prior 1-million-GPU commitment announced at NVIDIA GTC 2026 that AWS said demand had already exceeded.
why: A hyperscaler saying demand already ran past its previous GPU commitment is a revision upward in planned compute spend, not a restatement.

impact.mechanism: Exceeding an existing GPU commitment forces upward revision of capital plans for accelerators, facilities and power.

evidence.excerpt: on top of a prior 1-million-GPU commitment announced at NVIDIA GTC 2026 that AWS said demand had already exceeded

confidence.basis: Primary vendor newsroom announcement attributing the demand statement to AWS; no capex dollar revision is given, only unit commitments.
